subject.title: fix(cli): warn that attach --print-config prints a live bearer token

question: Should `attach --print-config` continue exposing the live token with an unconditional stderr warning, or should it also provide or require a log-safe/redacted output path?
rationale: The current workflow intentionally emits a usable credential, while warning-only, opt-in safe output, and removing direct token output have materially different compatibility and security consequences.

options.title: Accept the warning
options.body: Merge after redacted real-command proof, preserving the existing stdout JSON contract while accepting one new stderr warning.

options.title: Add safe output
options.body: Require a separately named redacted or non-secret summary mode and document its use for logs and support artifacts.

options.title: Redesign handoff
options.body: Pause this PR and stop printing live bearer material directly, accepting a larger compatibility change to the manual-launch workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept the warning
recommendation.body: Merge after redacted real-command proof, preserving the existing stdout JSON contract while accepting one new stderr warning.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current attach contract and are already the explicitly requested policy decision-maker in this PR discussion.
